proposals.before: He befriended the Daoist Li Daoyin and Luo Yin; the age called them the Three High Recluses.
proposals.after: He befriended the Daoist Li Daoyin and Luo Yinzhi; the age called them the Three High Recluses.
proposals.reason: Chinese 羅隱之 is the full personal name; idiomatic English drops 之 as Luo Yin.

proposals.before: He was friendly with the Daoist Li Daoyin and Luo Yin; the age called them the Three High Recluses.
proposals.after: He was friendly with the Daoist Li Daoyin and Luo Yinzhi; the age called them the Three High Recluses.
proposals.reason: Chinese 羅隱之 should be rendered Luo Yinzhi, not Luo Yin.

proposals.before: Mingzong summoned him as Left Reminder, Gaozu as Censor—he refused both and was named Master Free Wanderer.
proposals.after: Mingzong summoned him as Left Reminder, Gaozu as Grand Master of Remonstrance—he refused both and was named Master Free Wanderer.
proposals.reason: 諫議大夫 is Grand Master of Remonstrance / Remonstrance Counselor, not Censor.

proposals.before: He replied: “The Dao is that which subtly accounts for the ten thousand things in speech; one who attains its utmost can govern Heaven and Earth while the corpse lies between mat and coverlet.”
proposals.after: He replied: “The Dao is that which subtly accounts for the ten thousand things in speech; one who attains its utmost can govern Heaven and Earth while remaining still between mat and coverlet.”
proposals.reason: 屍居 is Daoist motionless stillness, not a literal corpse.

proposals.before: He began as a common soldier and rose by battle merit to regent of Luozhou.
proposals.after: He began as a common soldier and rose by battle merit to regent of Mingzhou.
proposals.reason: 洺州 is Mingzhou (Míngzhōu), not Luozhou.

proposals.before: In youth he was a common soldier; by battle merit he rose step by step to regent of Luozhou.
proposals.after: In youth he was a common soldier; by battle merit he rose step by step to regent of Mingzhou.
proposals.reason: 洺州 is Mingzhou, not Luozhou.

proposals.before: In the first month of the fourth year of Tianfu the Ministry of Revenue memorialized: “Li Zilun, Assistant in the Ministry of Revenue of Shenzhou, six generations dwelling together—per imperial order and statute.
proposals.after: In the first month of the fourth year of Tianfu the Ministry of Revenue memorialized: “Li Zilun, Assistant for Merit of Shenzhou, six generations dwelling together—per imperial order and statute.
proposals.reason: 深州司功參軍 is a prefectural Assistant for Merit, not an assistant in the Ministry of Revenue.

proposals.before: He was promoted to Vice Director.
proposals.after: He was promoted to Vice Minister of the Imperial Clan Court.
proposals.reason: 少卿 after 宗正丞 is the higher Vice Minister (少卿), not another Vice Director.

decisions.reason: Focus unit names 羅隱之 in full; the following unit abbreviates him as 隱之, not 隱. Rendering him Luo Yin drops 之 and risks confusing him with the Tang poet 羅隱; Luo Yinzhi restores the personal name accurately.
The literal field has the same truncation of 羅隱之 to Luo Yin; Luo Yinzhi matches the Chinese personal name and is consistent with the short form 隱之 in the next unit.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 與道士李道殷、羅隱之友善

decisions.reason: Focus unit has 諫議大夫 under Jin Gaozu; that remonstrance office is Grand Master of Remonstrance, not a censorate title. The proposed replacement corrects the office without altering the rest of the sentence.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 晉高祖時以諫議大夫召之

decisions.reason: Focus unit uses 屍居衽席之間 in the Daoist sense of remaining motionless between mat and coverlet; the prior literal 'the corpse lies' takes 屍 too literally. 'Remaining still' restores the intended stillness without inventing content.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 屍居衽席之間可以治天地也

decisions.after: He began as a common soldier and rose through battlefield merit to become Training Commissioner of Mingzhou.
decisions.reason: 洺州 is Mingzhou, and 團練使 is Training Commissioner rather than regent.

decisions.after: In youth he was a common soldier; through battlefield merit he rose step by step to Training Commissioner of Mingzhou.
decisions.reason: 洺州 is Mingzhou, and 團練使 is Training Commissioner rather than regent.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 以戰功累遷洺州團練使

decisions.reason: Focus unit has 深州司功參軍李自倫; 司功參軍 is a prefectural Assistant for Merit under Shenzhou, while 尚書戶部 only memorializes. The prior literal wrongly makes him an assistant in the Ministry of Revenue.
Prior unit appointed him 宗正丞; this unit’s 遷少卿 advances him within the Imperial Clan Court to 少卿 (Vice Minister), not another Vice Director. The proposed title restores that promotion.
